module: Simple shape generators for Track Builder obstacles: torus (ring), cylinder, cone, cube, bump and ramp. Each function returns a procedural mesh table {verts, uvs, normals, faces, material} ready to be passed to ProceduralMesh:createMesh({{mesh}}) (verts and normals are {x,y,z}, uvs are {u,v}, faces are {v,n,u} 0-indexed). The default material is 'track_editor_A_border'.
usage:
local mesh = util_trackBuilder_proceduralPrimitives.createCylinder(2, 5)
local obj = createObject('ProceduralMesh')
obj:registerObject('monCylindre')
scenetree.MissionGroup:add(obj.obj)
obj:createMesh({{mesh}})
notes: Parameters are first normalized (absolute value, default values); some are diameters: createCylinder and createCone divide the radius parameter by 2, and createRing multiplies radius by 2.
The number of segments depends on the size (for example cylinder: radius*8 clamped between 12 and 72), so large objects are more detailed.
createCube swaps the axes: size.x and size.y are inverted (size = vec3(|size.y|, |size.x|, |size.z|)).
The file also contains createIcosphere (local, not exported, with a call to be:reloadCollision); it is not accessible from outside.

createRing.desc: Torus (ring) centered on the origin, in the YZ plane.

createCylinder.desc: Cylinder with a Z axis centered on the origin, with top and bottom faces.

createCone.desc: Cone with a Z axis centered on the origin, tip pointing up.

createCube.desc: Cuboid centered on the origin. uvStyle chooses the UV layout (1 by default).

size.desc: Dimensions; vec3(1,1,1) by default. x and y are swapped internally.

uvStyle.desc: UV style (1 by default; the value is compared to 1).

createBump.desc: Bump (speed bump): base of length × width and top plateau of upperLength × upperWidth, with height height.

createRamp.desc: Ramp of length len, rising up to height hei. thinning narrows the width at the top, attack sets the curvature of the profile (power), twist adds a twist along the ramp.

thinning.desc: Width factor at the top, clamped to [0, 2] (0.5 by default).

attack.desc: Exponent of the height profile, minimum 1.

twist.desc: Total twist (0 by default; unit inferred from code: radians).
